body:
Ghost Lvl 32

Items: Wooden Sword / 3 Shurikens

Why Is This Kit Special: Is invisible.

This class is made for sneak attacks. Very low damage and no armor at all making this class very bad at defending and if caught there's not much chance of escaping. It's at such a high level because u can't be seen.
